text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I've finished writing up all 
the measurement logs up to today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they were just numbers I wrote down 
every day. And yet... they are precious 
proof of my growth, aren't they—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Kh, the record sheet...! Wait, stop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carried away by the wind, Ikuno Dictus 
lost track of her log sheet... and was 
left feeling down in the dumps.
